opportunities.title: The Long Rest Rule Half of You Are Already Houseruling Wrong
opportunities.why_now: A new D&D tavern-sim just made 'long rest' cozy again, but the actual 5e rule (one long rest per 24 hrs, interrupted by 1hr+ of combat/spellcasting) trips up more tables than any other resource rule.
opportunities.angle: 60-sec 'ruling of the day': read the exact PHB long rest interruption clause, give the classic 'watch got attacked at hour 7' ruling.

opportunities.title: Dark Sun's Defiler Magic Would Break 5e's Spell Slots — Here's the Fix
opportunities.why_now: The original Dark Sun creators just announced a 5e conversion of their Athasian setting, reviving the defiler/preserver magic split that vanilla 5e has no rules for.
opportunities.angle: Mechanical breakdown: propose a clean 5e subsystem (extra damage die vs. terrain drain) as a 'if you're bringing Dark Sun to 5e, steal this' short.

opportunities.title: Warlock's New Game Is Set in Ravenloft — So Here's How the Mists Actually Trap You (RAW)
opportunities.why_now: First gameplay footage for the D&D Warlock game just dropped confirming a Ravenloft setting, and most tables misplay the Mists as 'just fog' instead of the sentient plot device it is in 5e's Domains rules.
opportunities.angle: Rules ruling short: how Domains of Dread pull PCs in/out per Van Richten's, and the correct Dark Lord 'testing' trigger.

opportunities.title: Arcana Unleashed's Deadfall Preview Has a Spell That Actually Solves the Fall Damage Problem
opportunities.why_now: The Arcana Unleashed: Deadfall preview just went up showcasing new spell content aimed at fall/environmental hazards, a use-case veteran GMs constantly improvise around.
opportunities.angle: Spell use-case short: compare RAW fall damage math to the new spell's fix, verdict on whether it's worth porting into a home 5e/Shadowdark game.

opportunities.title: Improvising Rules Mid-Session Without Breaking Your Table (DCC/Shadowdark Edition)
opportunities.why_now: Gnomecast 244 just dropped a full episode on worldbuilding in the moment, a direct hit for the daily 'ruling of the day' format on how to adjudicate fast under OSR-style light rulesets.
opportunities.angle: Wry veteran-GM take: one concrete on-the-fly ruling example (e.g., improvised trap DC) contrasted between DCC judge-call style vs. 5e's codified DCs.
